aliases: 4MP Outdoor Fixed-focal 4G Battery Pan & Tilt Network Camera

power.method: Built-in 68 Wh lithium battery, USB-C charging, solar-charge compatible

features: wire-free 68 Wh battery, USB-C and solar charging
Smart Dual Light: IR up to 30 m + warm light up to 20 m
bundled as KIT/BP4A-4G/M0508 with an 8 W M0508 solar panel
release_notes: The Dahua BP4A-4G is a 4MP wire-free battery pan & tilt camera with a 68 Wh battery, Smart Dual Light (IR + warm) night vision, PIR sensor, AI human/vehicle detection and red/blue active deterrence; it is also sold as a KIT bundled with the M0508 8 W solar panel. Verified against the official Dahua datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: BP4A-4G: app-only via DMSS (4G/battery). No official ONVIF/RTSP; use the DMSS cloud app, or Generic Camera (RTSP) only if a local stream is later exposed.

blue_iris.notes: No confirmed local RTSP path; DMSS-managed 4G/battery camera.
